tips_en: Start with Paper 1 on World-Action Models for robotics—it ties together the video generation themes across all three papers by building on LongLive-style autoregressive video pretraining, and its real-world robotics results (95% success on dynamic cup stacking where baselines score 0%) make it the most broadly impactful. Follow up with Paper 3 (SGF+) if you want to understand the underlying autoregressive video generation technique, as its elegant decoupling of context-writing and denoising parameters could also benefit Paper 1's long-horizon rollout. Paper 2 (GRACE) addresses a complementary efficiency angle via latent compression and DiT acceleration, useful if deployment speed is your priority.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读第一篇关于世界-动作模型 (World-Action Models) 的机器人论文——它基于 LongLive 风格的自回归视频预训练，将三篇论文中的视频生成主题串联起来，且其实世界机器人成果（动态叠杯任务 95% 成功率，而基线为 0%）使其最具广泛影响力。若想深入了解底层的自回归视频生成技术，可以接着读第三篇 SGF+，它通过优雅地解耦上下文写入与去噪参数来提升长程一致性，第一篇也可借鉴此思路。第二篇 GRACE 则从潜在压缩与 DiT 加速的角度解决互补的效率问题，适合在部署速度优先时参考。
